name: Alpine Moon — an opponent's lands with the chosen name lose all land types and abilities and tap for any color
notes: Sweep group 2 (2026-10-07). "Lands your opponents control with the chosen name lose all land types and abilities, and they gain "{T}: Add one mana of any color."" parsed to nothing: no name prompt for "choose a nonbasic land card name", no filter by name, and nothing read "lose all land types". Chosen name Urza's Mine: the opponent's Urza's Mine loses its Urza's and Mine subtypes and its ability and has only the new one; the opponent's Forest and your own Urza's Tower are untouched.

abilities: {T}: Add one mana of any color.
